initial_full_suite.cause: An existing atomic-cancellation test monkeypatched the deletion queue with its old one-argument signature; adding conversation metadata caused TypeError before the test gate was entered
initial_full_suite.correction: Update the hook to accept/forward the conversation ID and preserve the same pause point, cancellation assertions and unchanged one-second observation gate

deadline_counterexample.cause: A slow encoder used the original source deadline even when its capture row had an earlier configured store deadline; a late unattached clip could be returned after that earlier expiry
deadline_counterexample.correction: AudioReservation returns the minimum effective store/source deadline; the archive owner uses that deadline for native admission and return checks, discarding the late file before attachment

focused_validation.scope: Final capture erasure, capture retention, all ambient unit cases, independent authority and journal/index coordinator cases

proven: main registers capture storage locations and the capture cleanup driver even with ambient or keep_audio disabled, before constructing/starting ambient producers
Attaching the actual graph verifies the shared authority, store and matching archive root, then persists the effective target before native file admission
An intent with path, conversation and expiry is committed before encoding; crash before attachment preserves a locator for erasure or active-store TTL cleanup
New policy clips use capture UUIDs so equal rowids from different databases do not overwrite or delete each other; files and new SQLite databases are 0600 and new final directories are 0700
The archive owner bounds native encoders to eight, guards source admission before/after reservation and native work, and retains actual writes through repeated caller cancellation
The minimum store/source deadline survives inside the native encoder owner rather than relying on a later audio-path attachment to reject an expired result
Conversation cleanup waits bound native encoders before atomically retiring matching raw rows, capture scopes and write intents while queuing file deletion
TTL purge preserves intents for still-running encoders and defers unlink until their actual exit; purge-before-erasure cannot lose a late file locator
Unlink failure keeps a pending count and durable locator through restart; erasure leaves unrelated conversations and their clips intact
All roots previously registered for the same database remain eligible after keep_audio.dir changes; an arbitrary unregistered path remains pending without deleting a foreign file
Existing-only cleanup does not create missing databases; orphaned clips without a database, corrupt databases and unreadable directories do not count as successful erasure
